question: At what line speed and chamber O2 level was the EB-cured electrode that faded, and what speed and O2 level gave cycling similar to the baseline?
expect: 500 fpm with 810 ppm O2 (moderate fade); 400 fpm with 182 ppm O2 similar to baseline (p9.L64-74)
rendered: The EB-cured electrode that faded was cured at 500 fpm with a chamber O2 level of 810 ppm. The EB-cured electrode that had cycling similar to the baseline was cured at 400 fpm with a chamber O2 level of 182 ppm.
